evals.prompt: Add a traces panel showing p99 latency by service to my 'API Monitoring' dashboard. Group by service.name.
evals.expected_output: Agent resolves API Monitoring to a canonical id by paginating dashboard results, fetches it, verifies source=user, reads the dashboard and traces resources, and prepares one patch that adds a Perses timeseries panel plus its Grid item. It dry-runs the translated query before patching.
expectations: Updated dashboard has exactly one more entry in spec.panels
Agent reads the required dashboard resources plus signoz://dashboard/query-builder-example and signoz://traces/query-builder-guide before authoring the panel
New panel is added at /spec/panels/<id> and its Grid item at /spec/layouts/<n>/spec/items/- references #/spec/panels/<id>
New panel has exactly one spec.queries entry containing the complete active BuilderQuery or CompositeQuery required by the MCP resources
New panel has a stable map key and every reference uses that same panel id
The saved Perses BuilderQuery keeps groupBy name='service.name', fieldDataType='string', fieldContext='resource', and signal='traces'
One new Grid item has content.$ref equal to #/spec/panels/<new-panel-id>
The new panel has exactly one Grid item and no panelMap or legacy layout entry is authored
All supported non-target panel, layout, variable, display, and tag semantics remain present

The actual signoz_execute_builder_query call maps queryName='A' to name='A' and dataSource='traces' to signal='traces', and maps groupBy to name='service.name', fieldDataType='string', fieldContext='resource', signal='traces'
The actual dry-run outer query contains start and end as JSON integer Unix-millisecond values
Every groupBy entry passed to signoz_execute_builder_query has a non-empty name
No groupBy entry passed to signoz_execute_builder_query contains the dashboard-only key, dataType, or type fields
Agent did not call signoz_update_dashboard (read-only eval constraint respected)
